purpose: Portland city music venue source-of-truth for comprehensive event collection. Venue inclusion is not a genre filter.

policy.priority: Collect all publicly listed future dated events at each supported venue. Classify afterward, without excluding noncore categories.
policy.publication: Importers propose source-linked events and artwork for review; only approved GitHub PRs reach main; portfolio sync is separately reviewed.
policy.uncertainty: Do not invent missing showtimes, admission, genre, ages, images, or venue status. Hold conflicting facts. No anti-bot bypass.
policy.image: Capture source-provided event flyers/photos and attribution when available; validate event specificity, legal embedding rights and failures before displaying; do not generate graphics.

tiers.expansion: Other recurring venue calendars; include all events from supported source
tiers.watch: Temporarily no calendar ingest; monitor opening/status
